title: Freeze What Is Settled, Cache What Is Smooth: Spatial Freezing Keeps Step Caching in Its Low-Error Regime
title_zh: 冻结已定部分，缓存平滑部分：空间冻结使步缓存保持在其低误差区间

paragraphs.en: 提出FreezePlan调度策略，结合区域冻结与步缓存，在Qwen-Image-2.1上实现5.05倍加速且保持高图像质量。 Instruction-based image editors built on diffusion transformers run tens of denoising steps. Training-free acceleration either reuses features across steps (step caching) or stops computing the regions an edit leaves untouched (region freezing), and the two have been combined before. We ask how a high speed-up target should be split between them. On Qwen-Image-2.1, freezing does more than remove tokens: it lowers the cost of every step, so the step cache can reach the same overall speed-up with a conservative threshold that keeps its error small. A per-step cost model fitted on development runs predicts held-out latency with a median error of 4.0% and reproduces the speed ceilings of the region methods we re-implemented (2.73$\times$ predicted vs. 2.70$\times$ measured for RegionE). Driving frozen tokens to the model's one-step $x_0$ estimate beats returning them to the reference image on every development sample, and in 90% of measured cases the composed error stays below the sum of the two individual errors. The resulting method, FreezePlan, keeps five full steps and gives the rest of the budget to TaylorSeer. On a pre-registered test split it runs 5.05$\times$ faster end to end at 29.8 dB PSNR to the original output, with no significant drop in a VLM judge score; TaylorSeer at 5.02$\times$ reaches 23.5 dB. The curve extends to 5.99$\times$ at 28.0 dB. Swapping in the region selectors of prior methods under our schedule lowers median PSNR by only 0.5--0.6 dB, which places the gain in the schedule and budget split rather than in the selector.
paragraphs.zh: 提出FreezePlan调度策略，结合区域冻结与步缓存，在Qwen-Image-2.1上实现5.05倍加速且保持高图像质量。基于扩散Transformer的指令式图像编辑器需要运行数十个去噪步。 免训练加速要么跨步复用特征（步缓存），要么停止计算编辑未触及的区域（区域冻结），此前已有将二者结合的做法。 我们探讨在给定的高加速目标下，应如何在两者之间进行分配。 在Qwen-Image-2.1上，冻结的作用不只是移除token：它降低了每一步的成本，因此步缓存可以用保守的阈值（保持其误差较小）达到相同的整体加速。 在开发集运行上拟合的每步成本模型预测留出延迟的中位数误差为4.0%，并复现了我们复现的区域方法的速度上限（RegionE的预测值为2.73倍，实测值为2.70倍）。 在所有开发样本上，将冻结token驱动到模型的单步$x_0$估计都优于将它们还原为参考图像；在90%的实测案例中，组合后的误差低于两个单独误差之和。 由此得到的方法FreezePlan保留五个完整步，并将其余预算分配给TaylorSeer。 在预先注册的测试集划分上，该方法端到端运行快5.05倍，相对原始输出达到29.8 dB PSNR，且VLM评审分数无显著下降；TaylorSeer在5.02倍加速下仅达到23.5 dB。 该曲线可延伸至5.99倍加速、28.0 dB。 在我们的调度下换入先前方法的区域选择器，中位数PSNR仅下降0.5至0.6 dB，这说明增益来自调度与预算分配，而非选择器。
